checks: The fixed finite set of contact labels permits a common subsequence for their coefficients. The own inball contains a planar ball in every nearby section since its offset is at most the common margin divided by u_min; the coarea also divides by at most u_max. In dimension one the corresponding counting mass is 1/|u|.

Summing the same-coefficient identity identifies kappa_j with the total coarea-weighted group mass. A positive group-weight limit then bounds kappa_j away from zero, and the joint zeroth and first moments give precisely the normalized law and common full physical barycenter.

The error e_j/kappa_j is a nonnegative weighted average of the contact margins and tends to zero. Both the converging covariance times bounded normals and the uniformly bounded b_ja are controlled, giving the section mean and normal balance for the same weighted law.

At each own-proper contact the clamp leaves its threshold unchanged. Uniform convergence of the record margins at the limiting marks therefore forces all support records through every limiting mark. Their proper sections persist by the inball. A point missed by every support cap has strictly negative continuous margin on the compact support, contradicting the zero average.

The mass-Q caps are attaining only when Q equals original unbuffered mixed maximum depth and the designated marks attain that maximum. The original 714f69e684c396b1 §5 makes the same conditional identification.
